title: 2027 Assembly Elections: BJP faces challenge of seat-sharing demands from allies in Uttar Pradesh
summary: The BJP is facing mounting pressure from its alliance partners over seat-sharing for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly polls. Smaller allies, including the Nishad Party and RLD, are staking claims for more seats than in the previous election.

title: The Battle for Uttar Pradesh: Who Has the Edge in the 403-Seat Race for 2027?
summary: Congress has begun seat-sharing talks with the Samajwadi Party and hopes to finish by mid-November; a Congress leader has demanded 150 of 403 seats while SP leaders say Congress deserves no more than 50. Former IAS officer Divya Mittal launched a new party, Jan Neeti Bharat, on 15 October to contest in 2027. The Election Commission has not announced dates.

title: Assembly Elections 2027: Polls in five states including Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand may be held in February-March next year
summary: The Election Commission has reportedly finalised a schedule to hold polls in Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Goa and Manipur together in February-March 2027, before the earliest assembly term ends on 13 March (Manipur). The Census is in its final stages in four of the states but postponed in Manipur.

title: ISI's 2027 assembly election plot: UP terror, Punjab drugs and Manipur unrest
summary: Intelligence agencies have reportedly warned of a Pakistani ISI plot to destabilise Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Manipur ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. Single-outlet report of intelligence warnings.

title: Himachal CM Sukhu challenges BJP's 2027 victory claims, says voters will decide; alleges party divided into five factions
summary: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu disputed the BJP's claim of winning a two-thirds majority in 2027, alleging the BJP is split into five factions and that its own surveys show it losing seats.

title: How 2026 election results will impact 2027 assembly polls in Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and other states
summary: Analysis of what the 2026 assembly results mean for the seven states voting in 2027; five of them are BJP-ruled, while Punjab is ruled by AAP and Himachal Pradesh by Congress.

title: Gujarat Election Opinion Polls 2027: Will AAP Challenge BJP in Gujarat?
summary: An early opinion survey for Gujarat 2027 shows a three-way contest, with the BJP comfortably ahead and AAP and Congress competing for second place. By 2027 the BJP will have governed Gujarat for 32 years.
